In regards to having a log: You can access the VRChat logs on your hard drive, here's how: https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/frequently-asked-questions#how-do-i-find-the-vrchat-output-logs
The log contains the times when a user joined the world (unless you joined after them). I've been able to use that info in the past to figure out who crashed my instance.
If - in addition to that - you have video evidence of a user doing something malicious, then you should report it to VRChat at https://help.vrchat.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=1500000182242
Also consider increasing your safety settings to decrease the odds of getting crashed. Crasher avatars usually have a poor rating or worse.
I think you should consider formatting your request differently. That 781 words, and... It's difficult to digest.

details: I'm fairly new paying $9.99 a month for VR Chat, and I'm on occulus and this annoys me, when I'm talking with others or trying to make friends, I get hit with crashers, usually I run into random worlds and I usually have to work up the courage to speak and wait a lil bit for conversation starters , but how about implementing a system that shows the logs of player and how long they been in the world and when they left for the last 3 or 2 worlds no matter if you powered off your occulus or PC so that way at the same time you could reconnect with the people you were just starting to make friends and take care of the crashers, because that way you could view see what people are there to Convo and those who are there to just crash also add an ability to also report or label people on their status as malicious users if they are using clients and such , that's to bad there's a log and if a enough people report and claim that you're a malicious user we could possibly remove them or ban them from the platform , should this be for avatar crashers, no but for the ones using clients and such yes , generally when I get crashed I know usually who does it, because I tell my friend to stay in the world, power off my occulus, power on, which takes 10secs, load back in the world, after I hide avatars and everything and I see the crasher talking trash and playing meme music right and saying things like "oh this questie is persistent" before I get a chance to even report how are you going to have a report button that's utterly useless unless you get their name %100 right or can't even remember, crashers are usually not in world's very long anyways they're just there to crash and leave but if you allow a log system and if enough people reports them for crashing there should be a way of punishing them so they just hop around into a new world and crash it aswell, also there needs to be some form of audio/video record so that way if we have video evidence of these crashers in action we could easily add it to report to even back it up, just tired of wasting my money on a social platform that can't even serve it's purpose, the log system could also be used to see the many times a player has entered a world, the time starting from the moment they entered or left , also add secs/min/hrs/days because I highly doubt anyone can stay in one world for an entire week and the crashers are generally in worlds for short periods of time and if the log system is working how I think it will it could narrow down the people who are doing it, also add a recent world tab(with world number) so instead of having a friend or other users to stay put so I could attempt to report also have included in the logs the fps , and ping everyone is running, bc when I re-enter a world I see them acting all smug and prideful while everyone else is frozen , though there is some backfire to this but a very intelligent person like myself , I would let them crash me a second time, without making threats of reporting or even uttering a word, just to make sure that they can't switch up and try to false report me with friends, it would be hypocritical or hilarious to see these said crashers trying to report everyone but themselves and gives those who want justice some form of being hidden, avatar crashers nah but the advance ones yes, and also how could they know that you're not just coming back to check on the world to see if the crashers left , coming to revisit your friend, and with the log recording the time(in world, not irl), fps, ping, the ability to instantly revisit a world(the exact same number and server) you were just at (even if game crashes, or powered off), it'll take all of their fun away and will make it a cleaner platform so all they will stuck with is obvious avatar and physics crashing, which anyone can see/report other than the advance method , also I'd love a very long and punishing ban for these guys, and making new accounts would also grow very tiresome for their toxic pleasure, I don't care if I'm hardcore targeted from now on by these types of people but somethings gotta change
title: Crasher Report System
